decision: Verified public internet, LinkedIn and external-provider evidence about a known connection or its company becomes standard context on the canonical relationship graph and must feed person, company, customer, opportunity and next-best-action intelligence.
prevention_rule: Never leave relevant external evidence as a report-only event. Attach it to the existing relationship graph, preserve source/freshness/confidence, and reuse it through canonical Powerhouse intelligence. LinkedIn activity is a signal, never standalone buying proof.
sources: DataForSEO/Tavily/provider evidence already admitted to runtime
root_cause: Verified public internet and LinkedIn evidence could exist as isolated runtime events without becoming standard reusable context on the known connection, company and customer graph.
prevention: Every verified external update about a known connection or its company is projected into the canonical relationship graph.
Preserve source, freshness and confidence; LinkedIn activity is a signal and never standalone buying proof.
Reuse existing predictive signals, company intelligence, connection profiles and commercial scheduler; never introduce a parallel CRM.
evidence: powerhouse_relationship_external_intelligence_v1 aggregates external runtime evidence by person and company.
powerhouse_project_external_relationship_intelligence_v1 projects company evidence into powerhouse_predictive_signals and connection context into bg_connecties.extra.
powerhouse_customer_external_intelligence_v1 exposes the same context for customers.
The canonical commercial cycle invokes external relationship intelligence before relationship-revenue and trigger acquisition.
